title: Revit governed workset assignment and containment
test_intent: Determine whether Revit worksets implement the governed S4 naming structure and S6 containment intent, including link placement, datum/reference containment, and prohibition of personal or uncontrolled production worksets.

applicability.applies_when: The tested Revit model is workshared and uses worksets for governed containment or ownership.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested Revit model is not workshared and no governed workset rule applies.

required_evidence: element-to-workset assignment inventory for links, datum/reference elements, and physical modeled elements
applicable governed workset naming syntax and project workset strategy

result_logic.pass: Applicable worksets conform to the available governed naming/containment rules, linked models reside on governed link worksets, datum/reference-only worksets contain no physical modeled geometry, and no personal or uncontrolled production workset is present.
result_logic.fail: A positive violation is found against an available governed rule, including a personal/uncontrolled workset, an incorrectly assigned link, or physical modeled geometry on a datum/reference-only workset.
result_logic.not_applicable: The model is not workshared and no governed workset rule applies.
result_logic.indeterminate: The project workset strategy, naming syntax, or classification needed to distinguish governed workset purposes is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E ATS. Source example workset names are not used as authority; evaluation depends on the governed project/S4 strategy.
